description: Invented demo Skill listings layered over an Exchange catalog snapshot. Not published on Tableau Exchange.

products.name: Marketing Campaign Analyst
products.short_description: Analyze email, ads and social campaign performance and suggest where to shift budget.
products.detailed_description:
Builds campaign views from your marketing data: spend, impressions, clicks, conversions and ROI by channel.

Flags underperforming campaigns and explains which channel or audience is driving the change.

Works with Marketing Cloud, Google Ads, Facebook Ads and spreadsheet exports.

details.installation_instructions: Open the Skills panel in Tableau, choose Add Skill, and select this listing. The Skill runs inside your Tableau session with your existing permissions.

products.name: Flowchart Builder
products.short_description: Turn process steps into a clean flowchart or process flow diagram in a Tableau dashboard.
products.detailed_description:
Lays out nodes and connectors from a table of steps and transitions, with automatic spacing and branch handling.

Highlights bottlenecks by colouring steps by volume or duration.

Good for workflow, approval and customer-journey diagrams.

details.installation_instructions: Open the Skills panel in Tableau, choose Add Skill, and select this listing. The Skill runs inside your Tableau session with your existing permissions.

products.name: Org Chart Generator
products.short_description: Build an interactive org chart from an employee and manager hierarchy.
products.detailed_description:
Reads employee and manager ID columns and draws the reporting hierarchy as a collapsible tree.

Supports headcount roll-ups and filtering by department or location.

details.installation_instructions: Open the Skills panel in Tableau, choose Add Skill, and select this listing. The Skill runs inside your Tableau session with your existing permissions.

products.name: KPI Scorecard Designer
products.short_description: Design an executive KPI scorecard with targets, trends and status indicators.
products.detailed_description:
Suggests KPI cards (BANs), sparklines and target comparisons for the metrics you choose.

Applies consistent formatting and colour rules for on-track, at-risk and off-track status.

details.installation_instructions: Open the Skills panel in Tableau, choose Add Skill, and select this listing. The Skill runs inside your Tableau session with your existing permissions.

products.name: LOD Calculation Helper
products.short_description: Write and explain FIXED, INCLUDE and EXCLUDE level of detail calculations.
products.detailed_description:
Describe the question in plain language and get a working LOD expression with an explanation of the grain.

Detects common mistakes such as filters that run after a FIXED calculation.

details.installation_instructions: Open the Skills panel in Tableau, choose Add Skill, and select this listing. The Skill runs inside your Tableau session with your existing permissions.

products.name: Data Model Advisor
products.short_description: Recommend relationships, joins and data types for a new published data source.
products.detailed_description:
Inspects your tables and proposes relationships and cardinality, then explains the trade-offs against joins.

Warns about fan-out, mismatched keys and fields with the wrong data type.

details.installation_instructions: Open the Skills panel in Tableau, choose Add Skill, and select this listing. The Skill runs inside your Tableau session with your existing permissions.

products.name: Dashboard Accessibility Checker
products.short_description: Check a dashboard for colour contrast, alt text and keyboard navigation issues.
products.detailed_description:
Reviews colour palettes for contrast, flags missing titles and captions, and checks tab order.

Produces a checklist of fixes ranked by impact.

details.installation_instructions: Open the Skills panel in Tableau, choose Add Skill, and select this listing. The Skill runs inside your Tableau session with your existing permissions.

products.name: Publish and Refresh Planner
products.short_description: Plan publishing, permissions and extract refresh schedules for a workbook.
products.detailed_description:
Recommends a project location, permission model and refresh cadence based on how the content is used.

Explains the impact of live versus extract connections on performance.

products.name: Sankey Flow Builder
products.short_description: Build a Sankey diagram showing how volume flows between stages or categories.
products.detailed_description:
Reshapes source, target and value columns into the paths a Sankey needs, then builds the chart.

Useful for funnel, customer journey and budget flow analysis.

products.short_description: Scaffold, test and document a new Tableau Skill before submitting it to Exchange.
products.detailed_description:
Generates a Skill manifest, example prompts and a test checklist from a short description.

Checks the listing text for missing capabilities and permissions before submission.
